policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 06. Reclassify one bounded 10-Person historiography/philosophy slice from legacy knowledge to culture. Every write requires live Production previous_domain=knowledge; any drift fails closed.

review_scope.selection_rule: Select ten current Production knowledge Persons whose representative historical identity is historiography, philosophy, political thought, or humanities scholarship. Use a smaller 10-Person unit because Bertrand Russell and William James require explicit boundary reasoning against formal inquiry/psychology.

entries.basis: V2 culture includes history and historiography. Livy's enduring representative identity is as the Roman historian of Ab Urbe Condita, not as a natural or formal scientist.

V2 culture includes history, literature, and humanities. Ban Zhao is represented as a historian, scholar, and woman of letters who completed the Book of Han and authored influential literary and didactic works.
V2 culture includes history and historiography. Tacitus is represented by the Annals, Histories, Germania, and Agricola; his senatorial career is secondary to his canonical historical authorship.
V2 culture includes history and historiography. Gibbon's representative historical identity is as the author of The History of the Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire.
V2 culture includes history and historiography. Ranke is a foundational figure of modern source-based historical scholarship and historical method.

V2 culture includes philosophy, jurisprudential thought, and social thought. Beccaria is most durably represented by On Crimes and Punishments and Enlightenment penal reform, rather than by commerce or empirical science.

V2 culture includes philosophy, political thought, and social theory. Although Mill also worked in political economy, his representative legacy is as a philosopher of utilitarianism, liberty, empiricism, ethics, and political philosophy.

V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Russell's mathematical logic creates a formal-inquiry boundary, but his representative historical identity is broader analytic philosophy, logic, essay writing, and social criticism; SEP identifies him foremost as philosopher, logician, essayist, and social critic and a founder of analytic philosophy.

V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. James spans psychology and physiology, but his representative historical identity includes foundational pragmatism, radical empiricism, philosophy of religion, and major philosophical influence; this unit resolves the interdisciplinary boundary in favor of culture.

V2 culture includes philosophy, political thought, and humanities. Gozze wrote philosophical dialogues and a major Aristotelian work on the state and republic; repeated civic office does not outweigh his representative intellectual authorship in this Person record.
